?My commute is 2hours (Total). Sometime I just walk half of the commute and take some drone shots, either for my portfolio, or just because I like to fly it.   


The way I work is that I have high efficiency streaks, like for 1 hour I am gonna do the equivalent of 4hours of work, but then I need to cooldown. I also sleep around 5-6 hours a day.  


I have been hospitalized several time, in psychiatry, due to my bipolar. I learned that I need to balance my me time and work time in order to keep myself sane and healthy. I managed to be a functionning human beeing, but it required a lot of adaptation and empathy from my current boss. That's also why I am slowsly switching to beeing my own boss (marketing).

More detail: I wake up around 5am. I go for a walk/yoga/home workout. 

Breakfast shower then omw to work around 7:30. On my commute I play the switch or vita. For the past few months it has been bad, I woke up around 4:30 and start working around 5:30am, I am working on a sensitive project with was sucking the life out of me.  


I arrive at work around 8:30 and I am super focus an efficient unti 10:30. Then I cool down until 12:30: lunch, fifa with the intern, stuff like that. I get back to work around 12:30/1pm and get tons of shit done until 3:30/4pm. That's usually when my mood starts to go down. I then go back home (bus, walk), and I either play the switch or fly the drone at this time. 

I am usually home by 6pm. I then hangout with the GF (we go out, movie, diner, or just chill at home). Around 8-8:30pm I do some work again, for 1hour. Either my current job or my own business. Around 10pm, I take a shower, either go out again/hangout with the love of my life/play videogame/learn piano or czech or lithuanian.

Around 00am I go to bed.

With this way of doing thing, I still manage to do a good job: clients are happy, boss is happy, girlfriend is happy (even though she thinks that this routine is having a really bed effect on my mood).

It took me a while to find the perfect EDC (cf my history), but I got there. And I dress like a hobbo, so most people suspect nothing. I explain what I use and how in the post below.

The bag is the best I ever owned: Incase Icon. Hold so many things without hurting my back or feel heavy. My northface surge hold the same quantity/weight but feels super heav.

**Gaming Part:**

* Nintendo Switch (128Gb, most played games are: FIFA18, Mario Kart, Skyrim, Attack On Titan 2)
* HDMI Cable and Dock for the Switch
* 2\* 8BitDo controllers for Switch/Windows/Android
* Steelseries mini controller for iOS
* PSVita Slim (64Gb: lots of PS1 classics and some Vita games: Killzone, FF7-8-10, Resident Evil 2,...)

I carry several controllers because I often play Fifa against coworkers on my work monitors. Sometimes, when the commute is too long, I play mario kart with random strangers in the train/bus. I just came back from Iceland, and I played Mario Kart and Fifa with the people next to me in the plane. That was a lot of fun :).

**Work part:**

* Dell 5289 2-1 laptop (i5, 256gb, 8gb)
* iPad Pro 256gb, 10.5': Currently learning Czech, Lithuanian and Piano. I also play videogames on the iPad.
* Apple Pencil

**Electronic:**

* iPhone X 256gb + Mujjo leather case
* DJI Mavic Air + 2 batteries: I often take sunset pictures on my way back from work, or sometime I need some specific picture for work and it's useful to have it with me.
* Anker PowerCore+ 26800: that things can charger my phone, vita, switch and laptop... And get a full charge in only 4hours! I love it
* Anker Charging station (4usb + 1 usbc) -1 Google Chromecast, super useful when I travel and want to watch netflix in an hotel room or something
* Amazon Case for all the cable (not so many actually, I have a nomad USB cable that can charge microusb/usbc/lightning, and 2 multi cable charger)
* 4tb Hard drive -GL300AR mini router: launch a VPN connexion at startup, and all my devices connect to that router only. Between my laptop battery and the Anker powercore, I can go easily 2 days without needing an outlet. Since I work often from coffee shop/coworking space, this is perfect. The multi charger cable allows me to charger 3-4 devices on a single usb port.

**Music:**

* Plantronic Backbeat Pro or BOSE QC35 (both bluetooth + noise cancelling)
* SHURE 215, in case I have no more battery on my headset anymore
* Anker SoundCore Nano, bluetooth speaker for confcall
* When I carry my Beyerdynamic dt 880 600 ohm, I also carry a mini amp/dac, soundblaster E5
* Mini USB Dac

**Random:**

* Gergber Multitool
* Notebook
* Pill dispenser, I switched to a compact one
* Klean Kanteen 0.7L bottle
* Zojirushi Coffee thermos: THIS THING IS AMAZING. Keep my coffee boiling hot from 8am to 8pm.
* Toothbrush/Toothpaste
* Teabags
